SHITET NJESI KOMERCIALE NE YZBERISH!
Shitet njesi komerciale ne Rrugen Besim Alla ,prane pallateve Cabej ne Yzberish.

title_en: COMMERCIAL UNIT FOR SALE IN YZBERISH!
description_en: COMMERCIAL UNIT FOR SALE IN YZBERISH! Commercial unit for sale on Besim Alla Street, near Cabej palaces in Yzberish. The premises is located on the 0th floor of a building built in recent years and is sold empty. It has a total area of ​​79 m2 and a rest area in front of the store of about 50 m2 which is dedicated to the store. The entrance area has a glass facade and can be used for various business premises.
